text: Changes to the security screening at City Hall earlier this year, changed waiting areas and access to the building for people with disabilities. For example, a formerly accessible public entrance at Elizabeth and Hagerman is changing to a staff entrance, potentially disadvantaging people with disabilities and removing one more accessible entrance/shelter that allowed people to wait for WheelTrans. I would like TAAC members to discuss the viability of designating a permanent location to be a WheelTrans pick-up area at City Hall, including ensuring that it is suitable for all makes of wheelchairs.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Requested representatives of Corporate Security to provide an overview at the September 24, 2020 meeting on changes to access at City Hall, including waiting areas for people with disabilities.
